description.text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY32,000/Year instead of CNY44,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply)

duration.text: The Engineering Mechanics at University of Jinan is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. application form 2. personal resume 3. scanned copy of passport 4. Graduation certificate and transcript of Masterr’s Degree 6. Study Plan in University of Jinan 7. Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1.The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3.Applicants must be in good health
